facts.statement: The study used a neonatal mouse model of hypoxic-ischemic brain damage to test the effects of formononetin given alone or with an Nrf2 inhibitor.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Researchers measured brain injury using both tissue examination and functional performance tests.

facts.statement: In a separate lab experiment, brain cells deprived of oxygen and glucose were treated with formononetin and specific inhibitors to study cell death and energy production.

facts.statement: Formononetin significantly reduced brain tissue death, swelling, and nerve cell damage in the injured mice.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The treatment decreased harmful levels of oxidative stress, excess iron, and cell death signals while increasing protective cellular factors.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Formononetin boosted the activity of the Nrf2 pathway in the brain's vulnerable edge area by moving the Nrf2 protein into the cell nucleus.
